scope: Native Ubuntu desktop candidate preparation; not Windows product deployment or native qualification
implemented: Primary desktop launcher uses the native workspace; the HTTP reference application has a separate hidden developer entry
Verity-protected closed content-custody policy requires genuine C on new lab and production images; missing policy refuses and production cannot select laboratory-file custody
Both governed-content controller and worker use that policy for workflow, envelope, publication, recovery and protected output delivery
Both backup controller and worker refuse manual non-C recipients on checkpoint images regardless of lab release signing
Native GTK and original-PAM terminal restore, exact-prefix resume and reviewed damaged-generation retirement with separate finite grants and explicit approvals
Durable no-overwrite inert resume data before restore or retirement dispatch; interruption does not infer rollback, success or automatic retry
Restore UI accepts native chronological publication suffix gaps caused by inert archived outcomes and rejects substitutions or reordered steps
C physical admission counts closed namespace entries, logical bytes and allocated extents including interrupted zero-EOF allocation
Both canonical PREPARED and exact PUBLISHED data files are allocated, synchronized and read back before TPM advancement
Existing-schema genuine Admin reconciliation can retire an exact reviewed partial or empty PUBLISHED only with canonical PREPARED, exact previous journal and unchanged pre-dispatch NV head
